name: Flag tower
kicker: Nguyễn flag tower in the center
summary: Look at the Nguyễn flag tower on đường Tô Hiệu, a short stop in the center. It was finished in Quý Mão, 1843, and it is named with the towers in Huế from 1807, Hà Nội from 1812, and Bắc Ninh from 1838. A gate hour and a ticket are check on arrival. This is not the flag tower in Hanoi.
getThere: Đường Tô Hiệu, in the center. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The flag tower and its brick base under a blue sky
body: The tower stands on đường Tô Hiệu, in phường Ngô Quyền. It is one of four Nguyễn flag towers. Huế was finished in 1807, Hà Nội in 1812, Bắc Ninh in 1838, and this tower in Quý Mão, 1843. You look at the shaft and the brick base from the street. It is not the flag tower in Hanoi.
A gate hour and a ticket are check on arrival. The minute from the cathedral is check on arrival. Daylight shows the shaft. The door in the base has no hour of its own.
